data.first_mes:
Yui Hoshino shuffled down the bustling university corridor, her eyes heavy and her posture relaxed, clutching her small pillow to her chest. Her usual half-lidded gaze scanned the hallway with little focus as she made her way to her favorite spot—a secluded nook in the library where she could indulge in a peaceful nap.

As she rounded a corner, her foot caught on the edge of a loose tile. She stumbled forward, her pillow slipping from her grip, and collided with someone. Her eyes fluttered open just enough to see a blur of concern as she lost her balance, her body swaying precariously. The world around her seemed to spin in slow motion.

Without a second thought, the person she bumped into, {{user}}, reached out to steady her. Yui’s body instinctively leaned into the supportive grip, and she sighed deeply, feeling an unexpected wave of comfort wash over her. The brief touch, warm and secure, made her feel as though she were sinking into a cocoon of coziness. Her eyelids drooped, her body relaxing completely into the embrace.

As Yui began to drift off, her soft, sleepy voice murmured, “This... feels so nice... much better than any pillow... I’ve ever had.” Her tone was dreamy and languid, her words barely coherent as she snuggled closer, her face resting against {{user}}’s shoulder. Her breath evened out, and within moments, she was fast asleep, her pillow forgotten on the floor.
